mapper.select: SELECT sdi.id, sdi.category_id, sdc.name as category_name, sdc.code as category_code, sdi.item_code, sdi.item_name, sdi.description, sdi.sort_order, sdi.is_default, sdi.status, sdi.extend_data, sdi.created_at, creator.nickname as created_by_name, sdi.updated_at, updater.nickname as updated_by_name FROM sys_dict_item sdi INNER JOIN sys_dict_category sdc ON sdi.category_id = sdc.id AND sdc.delflag = 0 LEFT JOIN users creator ON sdi.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN users updater ON sdi.updated_by = updater.id WHERE sdi.id = #{id} AND sdi.delflag = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_dict_item WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND delflag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dict_item SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND delflag = 0
